change: baseline state-agenda implementation
result: wide exhaustion improved, but recursive output and high arity exposed quadratic behavior

change: cache materialized (state, rank) subtrees and flatten finalized child ranks
result: unary recursive enumeration changed from quadratic to linear

change: filter rules using cached productive-state analysis
result: blocked-competitor family changed from quadratic to linear; cold irrelevant automata became about 10% slower

change: compact high-arity candidates as single-coordinate bumps with prefix/suffix scoring
result: second-tree high-arity scaling changed from quadratic to linear without division by child weights

change: defer successor expansion and use canonical unique predecessors
result: removed eager work and candidate deduplication set

change: fully iterative search and materialization
result: fixed deep stack overflow but increased constants on ordinary workloads

change: bounded recursive fast paths with iterative fallback
result: restored ordinary-tree performance while retaining depth-20000 stack safety

change: heapify ready candidates and add nullary/direct-pop/materialization fast paths
result: final wide-all speedup 302x; random speedups 1.29-1.69x

change: ablate nullary fast path, direct pop, and state heapify independently
result: at 4096 rules they save about 18%, 13%, and 18% on their target workloads

change: ablate known-child candidate pre-scoring
result: helps unary by 3% but slows 512-state random automata by 9%

change: ablate blanket deferred successor expansion
result: helps high-arity second-tree latency by 18% but slows long unary streams by 10%
status: revise to eager arity <=2 and deferred higher arity

change: ablate materialization cache, cached-child shortcut, and returned-root cache
result: cache removal is 128x slower and quadratic; shortcuts save 14% and 28-38%

change: ablate recursive search and recursive materialization fast paths
result: fully iterative variants slow random automata by about 9% and 7%; fallback still handles depth 20000

change: ablate productivity filtering
result: removal is 277x slower with 512 dead competitors, while improving cold irrelevant input by 20%

change: ablate factorized scoring and canonical successor generation
result: removal is 11.9x and 14.2x slower at arity 512 and trends quadratic

change: ablate flattened child-rank storage
result: per-item SmallVec is 5-11% faster on unary, high-arity, and random workloads

change: ablate compact bump candidates
result: explicit rank vectors are 3.1x slower at arity 512

change: ablate root heapify, root caching, and nullary materialization
result: root heapify is neutral-to-6% faster and simpler; root caching saves 28-38%; nullary shortcut saves 5-13%

change: remove losing optimizations and use arity-sensitive successor deferral
result: wide-all 313x, accepting-all 228x, high-arity-two 90x; random speedups 1.56-2.07x

change: add cold initialization and balanced-binary-tree asymptotic probes
result: found productivity saturation rescanned a d-ary rule d times for distinct children

change: record one dependency occurrence per child slot and decrement in O(1)
result: cold initialization exponent is 0.86 for wide rules and 1.00 for unique high arity through 16384

change: measure balanced binary trees through 65535 nodes
result: cold first-tree exponent 1.07, second-tree exponent 1.10, average next-128 exponent 0.76

change: sample optimized initialization, binary, wide, and unary paths at 4 kHz with Samply
result: initialization is allocation/hash-resize bound; binary/unary advancement is candidate/allocation bound; wide advancement is heap-pop bound

change: replace productivity hash-of-vectors with reusable DenseIndex CSR
result: 16384 distinct child occurrences improved from 599us to 109us (5.5x); 16384 nullary rules improved about 19%

change: store child ranks in zero/unary/binary/n-ary shapes
result: small unary/binary gains but leaf dispatch regressed; revised to keep rule index outside the shape enum

change: direct unary and binary successor generation and scoring
result: unary and binary-product workloads improved about 23-24%

change: move state streams behind compact handles in a contiguous arena
result: extra indirection slowed unary and binary workloads by about 10-20%

change: inline tiny ready/blocked batches and bypass one-element state heaps
result: large gains on deterministic states; unary 1024 fell from 150us to about 117us

change: leave initial rules in the automaton index behind a per-stream cursor
result: removed one allocation per touched deterministic state; binary first improved about 8-12% and unary fell further

change: pop generated candidates in place and preserve vector capacity
result: unary improved another 11%; binary product improved about 20-25%

change: replace state binary heap with a reusable quaternary heap
result: 4096-way exhaustion regressed roughly 45%

change: resolve nullary, unary, and binary initial candidates with shape-specific control flow
result: balanced binary first-tree latency improved about 4-9% at representative sizes

change: ablate singleton-nullary direct finalization
result: without it, accepting-first latency nearly doubled (2048 states: 115us to 223us)

change: replace pending-expansion vectors with cursors and defer binary successors until rank 1 is requested
result: 65535-node first tree improved from 20.5ms to 17.4ms; binary product also improved; steady advance remained substantially faster than old

change: move per-state heap and generated candidates behind one lazy boxed work object
result: smaller records nevertheless caused severe regressions across binary first and advancement

change: adaptively migrate state streams from direct hash entries to 64-state pages after 4096 touched states
result: 65535-node first tree improved from 17.3ms to 8.7-10.1ms and average next-128 from 130us to 77-82us

change: make page value vectors grow on demand rather than reserve 64 records
result: dense first-tree time 5-7% slower than full reservation but prevents pathological memory waste for sparse page access

change: lower page-promotion threshold from 4096 to 1024
result: did not improve medium trees and slightly hurt advancement

change: force paged storage from the first touched state
result: hurt wide exhaustion and large binary first-tree latency

change: benchmark packed-term-arena fixed-arity insertion in a release opt-level=3 thin-LTO harness
result: at 131071 nodes allocations fell from 65584 to 49 and construction from 1.214ms to 0.160ms (7.59x); full iterator was dominated by other work
status: keep upstream API; defer downstream use until release

change: upgrade to published packed-term-arena 0.1.3 and use allocation-free materialization paths
result: deep first-tree latency improved about 7% at depth128 and 9% at depth256; 65535-node balanced first remained in the 10-11ms band and 1.98x faster than old
